facts.fact: Avery 披露：父母上次来岛是一个月前，在 Welcome Center 与几位投资者开规划会；姐弟俩知道他们带投资者去了运河南端、Plunge 场地对面——"岛上要出大事就在这"。
facts.anchor: The last time our parents were here, about a month ago, they held a planning meeting at the Welcome Center with a few of their investors,

facts.fact: Max 插科打诨盼"F 是 fun"（4D 影院）；Sam 闪回去年马萨诸塞的自然灾害 4D 电影——"那么多好玩，因为都不是真的"。
facts.anchor: Personally, I’m hoping the F stands for fun.

facts.fact: Avery 仍替父母辩护"他们不会做违法的事，不会拿生意冒险——生意是他们唯一在乎的"；Sam 心头一刺：自己父母虽有怪规矩，但孩子永远第一。
facts.anchor: They wouldn’t risk losing their business

facts.fact: Jordan 拆穿："他们已经 desperate——desperate 的人会做坏决定"；Lily 不确定这话是在敲打自己还是给自己台阶。
facts.anchor: Don’t you two see? They’re desperate,

facts.fact: 峡谷竞速 Sam 摔赢 Max，被揉头发喊"你运气好"——他觉得这不是运气，是"revolution"：Paradise Sam 正在接管，也许能常驻。
facts.anchor: There was power in believing Avery and Max were his friends—and that he was worthy of their friendship.

facts.fact: 昨天还在说服 Lily"那是风声"的 ferocious growl 就在耳边炸响——这次轮到 Avery 抓哥哥胳膊、Max 面无表情；Sam 第一次看到他们"shred of vulnerability"。
facts.anchor: The ferocious growl Sam had tried to convince Lily was the wind, just yesterday.

facts.fact: 无窗建筑的双开门上方悬着牌子"He who kills with one leap"——Milo 解读：这是美洲原住民语 yaguar 的翻译，jaguar 名字的来源，指其偷袭扑杀+一口碎颅的猎技（顺带：时速 80 英里，食谱山羊/水豚/森蚺）。
facts.anchor: “He who kills with one leap,” Milo began, “is the translation of the Native American word yaguar, the origin of the name jaguar.

facts.fact: Avery 的"perks"口气第一次变得空洞单调；Max 低头认羞"我们不该再炫耀这个了"——Sam 看见他们盔甲的裂缝后决定坦诚：提议回度假村叫家长来现场。
facts.anchor: I feel like I was a completely different person a few minutes ago.

facts.fact: 提案被 Milo 用"没有真证据"驳回（"之前没人信我和 Lily，记得吗"）；Sam 主张叫家人来见证——正当此时又一声 growl，一道 midnight black 在峡谷顶端的林间掠过：美洲豹在"狩猎他们"。
facts.anchor: Especially without any real proof that there’s danger on the island,

facts.fact: Max 突然问"So what do we do, Sam?"（何时他成了领队？）——Sam 一声令下全队冲向双开门，Max 挥万能门禁开门，全员扎进绝对的黑暗里（章末悬念）。
facts.anchor: “Into the building!” Sam shouted before sprinting away.
